description: Join 2 to 50 PDFs, in the order given, into one new PDF. All pages of every input are kept. Writes a NEW .pdf inside the allowed folder and never changes or overwrites an existing file. Form fields are kept (a clashing field name is renamed, with a warning). The result starts from an empty document, so bookmarks, document metadata, page labels and layers are not carried over; they are listed in `lost`. Digital signatures are removed (the output is a new, unsigned document). Example: {"inputs":["a.pdf","b.pdf"],"outputPath":"merged.pdf"}. This is not redaction and does not sanitise. Use redact_pdf to remove sensitive content. Nothing is uploaded.

outputPath.description: new .pdf to create; must not exist

name: merge_pdfs
title: Merge PDFs
